prompt: Kelly says the web helps creators in two ways. One is selling directly worldwide. What do you think the second is?
options: It ends competition from other creators in every niche
It puts obscure items one click from bestsellers, so niche fans can find you
It turns most casual fans into true fans without any effort

private.resolution: The second is the network structure: the most obscure item is one click from the most popular one, which makes niche audiences reachable. Kelly does not claim competition vanishes.
